sources.source: DVSA annual report and accounts, 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The official report was published on 14 July 2026 and documents DVSA activity, services, accountability and finances for 2025 to 2026 across Great Britain.
sources.quality_effect: Adds vehicle-and-driver regulatory capacity context while retaining corporate-activity-versus-road-safety-outcome, service-volume, enforcement, testing, geography and financial-year guards.

sources.source: DVLA annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The 14 July 2026 report states that DVLA handled more than 100 million customer transactions, issued 12.3 million driving licences and made 751,058 medical licensing decisions during 2025 to 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds licensing-system capacity context while retaining transaction-versus-person, licence-issue-versus-entitlement, medical-decision, digital-channel and service-volume-versus-safety-outcome guards.

sources.source: UK Civil Aviation Authority Annual Report and Accounts 2025/2026
sources.verified_fact: The official annual-report collection includes CAP3276 for the period 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026, covering CAA performance, achievements, governance, accountability and audited accounts.
sources.quality_effect: Adds aviation-regulatory capacity context while retaining corporate-output-versus-accident, regulatory-function, reporting-period and audited-account-versus-safety-performance guards.

sources.source: UK Main National Aviation Safety Plan 2026-2029
sources.verified_fact: The current plan, version-dated 23 April 2026, sets the UK's three-year strategic direction for aviation-safety management and defines Safety Enhancement Initiatives intended to reduce operational risks and organisational challenges.
sources.quality_effect: Adds aviation-risk taxonomy and planned-control context while retaining plan-versus-delivery, initiative-versus-outcome, sector, exposure, implementation and no-causal-effect guards.

sources.source: Marine Accident Investigation Branch reports and current investigations
sources.verified_fact: The live official register displayed 1,099 marine investigation products when checked, while the current-investigations collection was updated on 14 July 2026. Reports distinguish occurrence date, vessel type and investigation-product type.
sources.quality_effect: Adds marine-investigation context while retaining notification-versus-occurrence, investigation-versus-casualty, report type, publication lag, vessel exposure and non-blame-purpose guards.

sources.verified_fact: The IOPC official publications library lists its 2024/25 annual report and accounts as published on 16 July 2026 alongside current policy and casework publications.
sources.quality_effect: Adds police-oversight governance context while retaining complaint-versus-case, investigation route, publication-year, corporate-performance-versus-police-misconduct-incidence and case-completion guards.

sources.source: Ofgem annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.authority: Office of Gas and Electricity Markets
sources.verified_fact: Ofgem's official collection includes the 2025 to 2026 annual report and common-core regulatory tables, covering policy delivery, energy regulation, parliamentary accountability, spending and governance.
sources.quality_effect: Adds energy-regulatory governance context while retaining corporate-output-versus-outage, policy-versus-delivery, budget, market, network and security-of-supply outcome guards.

sources.authority: Office of Gas and Electricity Markets
sources.verified_fact: The 9 June 2026 report updates Ofgem's work to strengthen energy-supplier financial resilience during 2025 and 2026 and assesses progress against requirements introduced after the 2021 and 2022 energy crisis.
sources.quality_effect: Adds supplier-failure resilience context while retaining financial-health-versus-network-reliability, requirement-versus-compliance, supplier-versus-network, consumer-protection and no-outage-incidence guards.

sources.source: RIIO-2 Electricity Distribution annual report 2024 to 2025
sources.authority: Office of Gas and Electricity Markets
sources.verified_fact: The 15 January 2026 report assesses electricity-distribution network-owner output delivery and financial performance using annual company submissions required by Regulatory Instructions and Guidance.
sources.quality_effect: Adds distribution-network performance context while retaining company-submitted data, output-target, expenditure, interruption-versus-performance and reporting-year guards.

sources.source: RIIO-2 Gas Distribution annual report 2024 to 2025
sources.authority: Office of Gas and Electricity Markets
sources.verified_fact: The 15 January 2026 report reviews gas-distribution network-owner output delivery and financial performance using RIGs submissions and company-level engagement.
sources.quality_effect: Adds gas-network delivery context while retaining company-submitted data, output-versus-incident, expenditure, network-owner, leakage-and-replacement metric and reporting-period guards.

sources.verified_fact: The official statistics published on 2 April 2026 compare daily registered deaths during defined heat episodes with baseline daily deaths and, from 2022 onwards, also compare observed estimates with modelled estimates based on earlier summers.
sources.quality_effect: Adds extreme-heat health-impact context while retaining heat-episode definition, registered-death lag, observed-versus-modelled estimate, uncertainty, region, age and no-parcel-causality guards.

sources.source: Quality and methodology information: Heat mortality monitoring reports
sources.verified_fact: The QMI updated on 2 April 2026 records a 2025 definition change to heat episodes based on mean Central England Temperature of at least 20°C, uses ONS death registrations extracted in March 2026 and excludes deaths mentioning COVID-19.
sources.quality_effect: Adds reproducibility and comparability controls while retaining definition-change, extraction-date, registration-lag, exclusion-rule and pre/post-series guards.

sources.source: Cold mortality monitoring report, England: winter 2024 to 2025
sources.verified_fact: The first annual report, published 18 February 2026 as official statistics in development, estimates 2,544 cold-associated deaths across three cold episodes, with a 95% confidence interval of 1,965 to 3,131.
sources.quality_effect: Adds cold-weather health-impact context while retaining modelled-attribution, delayed-effect, confidence-interval, episode, age, place-of-death and no-individual-causation guards.

sources.source: Quality and methodology information: Cold mortality monitoring reports
sources.verified_fact: The 18 February 2026 QMI explains the temperature-mortality model, data sources, assumptions, uncertainty and delayed timing used for the new annual cold-mortality statistics in development.
sources.quality_effect: Adds methodological controls while retaining modelling-window, threshold, lag structure, uncertainty, recent-versus-previous-period and development-statistics guards.

sources.verified_fact: The official surveillance collection was updated on 16 July 2026 with the 2026 to 2027 weekly series, which is used to detect and report weekly deaths above expected seasonal levels.
sources.quality_effect: Adds near-current mortality-signal context while retaining registered-versus-occurrence date, expected baseline, weekly volatility, delayed registration, all-cause-versus-cause-specific and no-local-parcel inference guards.

sources.source: National Highways annual report and accounts 2026
sources.verified_fact: The official report published on 13 July 2026 covers National Highways' performance and achievements in operating, maintaining and improving England's strategic road network during 2025 to 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds strategic-road operational capacity context while retaining corporate-output-versus-collision, network-only scope, maintenance, enhancement, financial-year and performance-target guards.

sources.authority: Department for Transport and National Highways
sources.verified_fact: The Secretary of State's report published on 16 July 2026 assesses National Highways between 1 April 2025 and 31 March 2026, including enhancement and renewal delivery and operational performance.
sources.quality_effect: Adds parliamentary performance oversight while retaining target-versus-outcome, capital-delivery, renewal, operational metric, monitoring-source and network-scope guards.

sources.source: ORR annual assessment of National Highways performance: April 2025 to March 2026
sources.verified_fact: ORR published its latest independent annual assessment on 17 July 2026, covering National Highways' targets, commitments and capital programme with associated enhancement, performance, operations, maintenance and renewals dashboards.
sources.quality_effect: Adds independent-monitor crosscheck context while retaining dashboard-versus-audited-statistic, target, commitment, capital programme, monitor role and no-parcel-risk guards.

quality_guards: AREA_LEVEL_PROXY only; no parcel measurement claim.
Corporate annual reports describe activity, governance and finance rather than accident, outage or harm prevalence.
Licensing transactions, medical decisions, tests and regulatory outputs are distinct from road-safety outcomes.
Aviation safety plans and enhancement initiatives are planned controls and do not prove delivered effects.
MAIB register entries, occurrences, investigations and publications have different units and timing.
Police-oversight casework and IOPC corporate performance do not measure police misconduct prevalence.
Energy supplier financial resilience, network-company output reporting and physical supply reliability are separate concepts.
Heat and cold mortality estimates depend on episode definitions, baselines, models, registration timing and uncertainty.
Weekly all-cause mortality surveillance is a signal against seasonal expectation, not a cause-specific parcel-risk measure.
National Highways and ORR reports cover the strategic road network, delivery targets and capital programmes rather than individual-site risk.
The uploaded 046 note remains non-canonical without matching task, heartbeat, claim and receipt evidence.
No existing candidate score, endpoint manifest or stored parcel value was modified.
